note: conversion of point small2_3 given in the macro set: the other two sets are the expected scalars; k21_ge_k31 is the labelling flag

quantities.conc: concentration in the central compartment (apparent for extravascular input), 0 before the dose and before the lag; the bolus at t = 0 is D / vc
quantities.auc: area under the concentration curve from the dose time to the time
quantities.aumc: area under the first moment curve from the dose time to the time
quantities.scalar: alpha > beta > gamma; k10, k12, k21, k13, k31; cl, vc, q2, vp2, q3, vp3; a, b, c (INTRAVENOUS coefficients D*w/vc for every route); w_alpha, w_beta, w_gamma; half_life = ln2/gamma, half_life_alpha, half_life_beta, half_life_gamma; vss, vz = cl/gamma, v_extrap = vc/w_gamma; auc_inf = D/cl; aumc_inf; mrt_system = vss/cl; mrt = mrt_system + m; c0 (bolus); tmax_pred, cmax_pred (not the bolus; absent for a zero dose with first-order input); k21_ge_k31 (1 when k21 >= k31)
quantities.scalar_ill: the scalars whose condition number (conditions) exceeds 1e3 with respect to the parameters of the case: written, with their condition, but outside the group the engine is held to at MODEL_VALUES; the decision is the orchestrator's

method.closed_form: independent implementation of the explicit sums of exponentials (MOD-3C-10 to 14), 256-bit arithmetic (Rmpfr); the exponents are the roots of the cubic found by Newton inside the brackets given by the critical points of the cubic, the weights the product-of-differences form (checked against the sum-of-positive-terms form), AUC and AUMC exact integrals of the terms; the confluent limit is used when |ka - lambda| is below 2^-150
cross_checks: matrix exponential (expm) of the 7-state system on intervals of constant input
adaptive ODE solver (deSolve lsoda, rtol 1e-12) with AUC and first-moment states
eigenvalues of the 3 x 3 system (alpha and gamma always, beta when the gaps exceed 1e-3)
